rules.text: src/test/corpus/ holds frozen evidence written by a released build. Never edit or regenerate it; migrate the data instead, and give a new schema version a new corpus file beside it (CLAUDE.md, Backward compatibility).

No static `@tauri-apps/*` import anywhere in src/: it puts Tauri in the web bundle. Use `await import()` inside a function behind isDesktop(), in src/platform/, src/desktop/ or src/storage/fileStore.ts (`import type` is fine). Guard: src/test/tauriImports.test.ts.
`import('@tauri-apps/...')` belongs only in src/platform/, src/desktop/ or src/storage/fileStore.ts. Call a function from src/platform/ instead. Guard: src/test/tauriImports.test.ts.

Shared modules never branch on a question-type literal ('mcq' / 'structured'). Put the per-type behaviour on the registry definition (src/registry/) and call it through the registry. Guards: src/registry/registry.test.ts and the noTypeBranching tests.
New Worksheet field(s) {names} are not in KNOWN_KEYS (src/model/migrations.ts). Add them there too, or they save and vanish on reload (docs/RECIPES.md, Add an optional Worksheet field).

question.instructions: The `change` edits the TypeScript types that describe a saved worksheet document. Does `change.added` add a property that saves a result the app computes from the document's content: a question's own number, a numbering label such as '(a)' or 'Q3', or a total of marks summed over several parts, questions or sections?

criteria.true: The property caches a computed result, e.g. `number: number` on a question, `label: string` holding '(ii)', `totalMarks: number` kept equal to the sum of the questions' marks.
criteria.false: The property holds something the teacher chooses or types: marks for one part or sub-part, where numbering starts, how many versions to print, a flag that chooses whether to show a total, or any property that is not a computed number, label or total.

rules.text: Numbering and marks are derived, never stored (CLAUDE.md). Compute it (src/model/numbering.ts, src/model/marks.ts) instead of adding a stored field.

question.instructions: The `change` edits a React component that renders the printed worksheet page. Does `change.added` add a new on-screen editing control (a button, grip, handle, toolbar, outline, badge, hint or overlay that exists only to help editing) rendered on the page?

criteria.true: It adds a new JSX element for an editing control or on-screen hint that a printed copy of the worksheet must not show.
criteria.false: It adds or changes content that is meant to print (question text, labels, lines, tables, figures), only changes logic, styles or props, or edits a comment.

rules.text: New on-page chrome needs `data-print-hide`, or it lands in the PDF (docs/RECIPES.md, Add on-page chrome).

question.instructions: Is there an em dash (—) inside words that `change.added` shows to teachers on screen in the app, such as a label, button, hint, dialog, empty state, placeholder or toast?

criteria.true: An em dash sits inside a string literal or JSX text that the app displays on screen.
criteria.false: Every em dash is in a code comment (//, /* */ or {/* */}), in a developer-only message, or in text printed on the worksheet paper.

rules.text: No em dash in teacher-facing screen text: reword with a full stop, colon, comma or parentheses (printed paper text and code comments are exempt).
